pages.title: Egg Escape Tycoon
pages.creator: Game Fun Life
pages.description:
Egg Escape Tycoon combines egg stealing, pet collecting, and base progression in a 3D multiplayer game for up to four players. Sneak around roaming guards, take eggs from rival bases, and carry them back to your own before you are caught. You also need to protect the eggs you already have.

Hatch your collected eggs into pets that generate coins, then spend your earnings on upgrades and new trails. Treadmill training improves your speed, while rebirth increases your income multiplier. Quests and daily rewards provide additional goals alongside the raids. Building up your base depends on balancing trips for more eggs with developing the pets and upgrades that support your income.

pages.title: Archer vs Monsters
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Time arrow shots into rotating targets in Archer vs Monsters. Every successful arrow stays embedded, leaving less open space for later hits. Study each monster's turning pattern and avoid striking an occupied spot, because hitting an earlier arrow ends the raid.

pages.title: Hyper Wave Challenge
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Guide a zigzagging character through levels in Hyper Wave Challenge. Hold the control to rise and release it to descend, steering around hazards along the route. Collect coins and pass through portals while working toward the end of each course.

pages.title: Mojicon Spring Connect
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description: Restore a spring landscape in Mojicon Spring Connect. Match identical seasonal tiles to clear the boards and earn rewards while following a bunny companion's story. Collect illustrated Spring Wisdom cards as you continue bringing the meadow back to life.

pages.title: Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle
pages.creator: Bouraoui Game
pages.description: Assemble artwork against a countdown in Jixora – Jigsaw Solitaire Puzzle. Drag pieces into position and let neighboring matches snap together. Earn stars from completed images, use hints or time freezes when needed, and unlock Free Play for adjustable puzzle sizes.

pages.title: Monster School 3
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Draw safe passages for the students in Monster School 3. Create floors and ceilings that keep the monsters away from traps and lead them toward the finish. Each survival challenge depends on shaping a route that the characters can cross safely.

pages.title: Enchanted Mahjong Saga
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear matching tiles before time expires in Enchanted Mahjong Saga. Work through progressively harder layouts and use hints when another pair is difficult to find. Keep the successful run going by emptying each board within its countdown.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Bike Rush
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Ride a meme character through floating courses in Italian Brainrot Bike Rush. Jump over traps, gather coins, and unlock checkpoints across five levels. Choose Normal, Challenge, or One Life play and compete alone or with a second rider.

pages.title: Br Br Patapim: Obby Challenge
pages.creator: Nexus
pages.description: Navigate a comic obstacle course in Br Br Patapim: Obby Challenge. Run and jump between platforms while watching for traps along the route. Use the camera to inspect the surroundings as you guide the meme-inspired character through each parkour level.

pages.title: Mini Games Relax Collection 2
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Choose among short activities in Mini Games Relax Collection 2. Use mouse or touch controls to work through the different minigames and their interactions. The collection lets you switch between casual challenges rather than following a single extended game format.

pages.title: GT Formula Championship
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Race open-wheel vehicles in GT Formula Championship. Steer through the circuit and compete against other drivers in high-speed encounters. The game centers on keeping the Formula car under control while working toward a better position against the racing field.

pages.title: Dynamons 11
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Recruit creatures and explore new areas in Dynamons 11. Weaken opponents through turn-based attacks, then catch them to expand the team. Use action cards and backpack items while traveling through Guardian Island and its bonus cave with guidance from Jovani.

pages.title: Basket Sport Stars
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Compete on changing courts in Basket Sport Stars. Choose tournament, quick-match, practice, or two-player activities and take on opponents with a selected character. Gift boxes add usable bonuses while the game's basketball contests mix movement, shooting, and direct attacks.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Crime Scene
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Search for evidence in Hidden Objects Crime Scene. Inspect the location and find every item listed below the scene before time runs out. Completing one investigation opens another area, giving you new details to examine for the next set of clues.

pages.title: Bolts and nuts
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Remove the boards in Bolts and nuts by relocating their fasteners. Unscrew a chosen bolt, then place it in a suitable open hole to change what remains supported. Plan the sequence so every plank can eventually be released.

pages.title: Farm Block Puzzle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Arrange shaped pieces on a rural-themed board in Farm Block Puzzle. Fill complete rows and columns to remove blocks and create space for later choices. Consider how each shape fits the remaining gaps before committing to its position.

pages.title: Stickhole.io
pages.creator: Byte Blasters
pages.description: Gather fighters with a moving hole in Stickhole.io. Swallow stick figures to build the group, then use the collected characters in a boss battle. Play timed single-player challenges or compete with another person to assemble the larger force before the fight.

pages.title: High Heels 2
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build taller footwear while running in High Heels 2. Slide toward heel sections and stack them beneath the character, then use the accumulated height to cross brick barriers. Keep collecting enough pieces to make it through the route to the destination.

pages.title: World War Brothers WW2
pages.creator: AngryGamez
pages.description: Fight in historical-style team matches in World War Brothers WW2. Join Allied or Axis players, capture points, and attack enemy bases using period-themed weapons. Equipment controls include grenades, flashbangs, bomb planting, and defusing for the different combat objectives.

pages.title: Fox Coin Match
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Combine currency in Fox Coin Match. Stack identical money to exchange it for larger values and work toward thousand-value bills that clear nearby pieces. Successful exchanges keep the counter from advancing, giving you room to continue reorganizing the money.

pages.title: Makeup Studio Halloween
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create seasonal beauty designs in Makeup Studio Halloween. Follow three influencer-inspired approaches and experiment with spooky cosmetics for the characters. Coordinate the makeup colors and details into complete Halloween looks rather than treating every face the same way.

pages.title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks 4
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Travel through card puzzles in Solitaire Story TriPeaks 4. Select tableau cards one rank above or below the current discard and draw from the stock when needed. Clear each field while Foxy leads the journey through different countries and landmarks.

pages.title: Minicraft
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Shape a block-built world in Minicraft. Build freely with unlimited resources in creative mode or gather materials and make weapons and armor in survival. Explore the environment and confront hostile creatures while developing the structures you want to create.

pages.title: Odd Elimination
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Spot the picture that does not belong in Odd Elimination. Compare five images and choose the unusual one to complete the puzzle. Incorrect selections cost points, while a rewarded hint can reveal the answer when a particular set leaves you stuck.

pages.title: Jelly Boom
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Trigger expanding reactions in Jelly Boom. Tap sweets to grow and burst them, using a limited number of clicks to remove the level's targets. Ice, firecrackers, and bombs change how later puzzles react, giving you additional tools for starting a useful chain.

pages.title: Sarens
pages.creator: Booblyc OU
pages.description: Protect a threatened valley in Sarens. Choose an elemental spirit and use its magic and abilities against enemies attacking the survivors. Victories provide rewards, while stronger modes introduce further tests against armed foes, hostile spells, and golems.

pages.title: Extreme Cycling
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Ride downhill across varied terrain in Extreme Cycling. Steer left and right through routes ranging from snowy mountains to sunlit deserts. Upgrade the bicycle after rides and unlock further modifications as you continue through the different freeriding locations.

pages.title: Grand Theft Stunt
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Finish hazardous driving stages against a timer in Grand Theft Stunt. Steer a luxury car along precarious routes and keep it clear of the cliffs. Ten levels challenge you to balance cautious handling with arriving before the time allowance expires.

pages.title: Rabbit Samurai 2
pages.creator: Miniduck
pages.description: Roll and swing through a forest in Rabbit Samurai 2. Use a grappling rope to reach lost bees and return them to the beekeeper. Collect carrots and secret crystals along the way, with a larger carrot haul unlocking a hidden running stage.

pages.title: ZigZag Bridges
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Prepare crossings for a moving runner in ZigZag Bridges. Tap to rotate a bridge as the character approaches, connecting the next part of the route. Keep adjusting in time to let the endless run continue across the changing gaps.

pages.title: Robber Vs Police: Fighting
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Fight criminals at close range in Robber Vs Police: Fighting. Guide the officer toward the robbers and choose the right moment to land a punch. Check the surroundings as opponents approach, using direct attacks to clear the encounter.

pages.title: Paint House
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Cover every bare section in Paint House. Swipe in four directions to guide the painting movement and fill the remaining white spaces. Plan a route through each building's surface so no unfinished patch is left when the level is complete.

pages.title: Apocalyptic Disaster Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Find concealed stars in Apocalyptic Disaster Hidden. Each of six pictures contains ten targets to locate before time expires. Repeated incorrect clicks deduct extra seconds, making careful inspection more useful than selecting random parts of the disaster scenes.

pages.title: Perfect Wax 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Collect body hair during a running challenge in Perfect Wax 3D. Shave as much as possible along the route and carry it toward the destination. The gathered hair is then used on the bald character waiting at the finish.

pages.title: The Cargo
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Load freight and complete its delivery in The Cargo. Use a crane to attach goods to the truck, then drive them to the warehouse. Faster jobs unlock achievements and earn money for truck improvements, linking careful loading with the transport route.

pages.title: Shot Shot
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Beat a countdown in Shot Shot. Tap quickly and accurately to send basketballs toward the arcade hoop and build a higher score. Keep making successful shots within the time limit as you work to outperform the recorded totals.

pages.title: Skate Rush Challenge
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Turn a school into a skating course in Skate Rush Challenge. Help Kick ride through the corridors and work toward finishing his new skateboarding challenge. Guide the character through the route as he tries to prove his skills on the improvised rink.

pages.title: Kingdom of Ninja 5
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Survive a lava-filled dungeon in Kingdom of Ninja 5. Jump past traps, monsters, and sharp rotating wheels while looking for the treasure chest. Reach it to finish the level and continue through the next part of the dark underground course.

pages.title: Capture the Chickens
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Recover missing farm birds in Capture the Chickens. Guide Ariel through traps and obstacles, gathering apples and other useful items along the route. Use the magic wand when a chicken is found to transfer it into the collection and continue the search.

pages.title: Hammer Master
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Drive matching nails in Hammer Master. Slide the hammer toward nails of its current color and avoid rocks that can end the attempt. Fill the energy meter to activate a special ability, then see how many nails you have successfully struck.

pages.title: Dino Egg Defense
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Stop a moving chain in Dino Egg Defense. Fire eggs to form matching groups of at least three and remove them before they reach the base. Work through the marble-shooting layouts and aim for a three-star completion in each level.

pages.title: Sweet World
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Collect rewards through candy puzzles in Sweet World. Form matching groups, complete the level objectives, and gather coins as you travel across the sugar-themed adventure. Achievements provide additional goals alongside progressing through the matching stages.

pages.title: Pirate Travel Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Color seafaring illustrations in Pirate Travel Coloring. Choose one of eight pictures and apply shades from the available palette. Finish the pirate scene in your preferred colors, then save the drawing when you are satisfied with its appearance.

pages.title: Funny Rescue Carpenter
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help an injured worker in Funny Rescue Carpenter. Select medical tools and work through the treatment sequence for Leia after her accident. Complete the activities needed to attend to her wounds and prepare the character for recovery.

pages.title: Crazy Friends Travel The World Puzzle
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Assemble travel scenes in Crazy Friends Travel The World Puzzle. Join illustrated animals visiting cities such as Paris, Moscow, and New York across twelve countries. Fit the puzzle pieces together to rebuild each destination's picture as the journey continues.

pages.title: Cats Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear feline-themed tile pairs in Cats Mahjong. Find identical cat pictures and select the usable matches to remove them from the board. Continue opening the layout through successful pairs until all the remaining animal tiles have been cleared.

pages.title: Princess Collage Random Day
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare outfits for varied activities in Princess Collage Random Day. Help the students dress for class, sports, parties, and time in the dorm. Choose clothing combinations suited to each event as you work through their changing college-day schedule.

pages.title: Island Defenders
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Protect a home base from extraterrestrials in Island Defenders. Aim and shoot at attacking aliens while collecting ammunition, bombs, and health. Gather the support needed to activate an armored helicopter and add heavier firepower to the island's defense.

pages.title: Arkadium's Jewel Shuffle
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Manage a move allowance in Arkadium's Jewel Shuffle. Swap adjacent gems to form rows of at least three identical pieces and collect points. Longer matches create bonus gems, helping you clear more of the board before the remaining moves run out.

pages.title: Dodge or Die
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Survive a hostile room in Dodge or Die. Keep the character away from aliens that crawl or jump toward it, avoiding any contact. Collect the diamonds appearing around the room to earn points while continuing to evade the attackers.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Romantic Anniversary
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Join a couple's celebration in Dotted Girl Romantic Anniversary. Help them share kisses and conversation as they approach the one-year mark of their relationship. Continue the evening with music, strawberries, and festive refreshments after the anniversary arrives.

pages.title: Sort It 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Separate colored balls in Sort It 3D. Move pieces between cups until each contains only its matching color. Plan the transfers around the available space and work on completing each sorting arrangement more efficiently.

pages.title: MineRunner
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Guide a block-style character through a side-scrolling course in MineRunner. Use jumps and double jumps to cross the platforms and reach the items along the route. Keep the runner moving safely while gathering collectibles through the level.

pages.title: Jump Ninja Jump
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Stay clear of throwing stars in Jump Ninja Jump. Jump or duck as shurikens approach and choose the movement that leaves a safe passage. Survive for as long as possible and increase your score by keeping the ninja out of their path.

pages.title: Insight Master
pages.creator: Saxxa Games
pages.description: Choose hidden answers in Insight Master. Tackle short luck-based tasks such as finding a pearl in a shell, locating a specific playing card, or selecting a wire. Each stage presents another uncertain choice as you try to progress through the arcade challenge.

pages.title: Under Water Bicycle Racing
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Race a bicycle through an aquatic setting in Under Water Bicycle Racing. Control the underwater cycle and work through its racing routes while trying to improve your performance. The unusual environment places the familiar riding challenge beneath the water's surface.

pages.title: Slot Katana Fruits
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Spin a fruit-themed virtual slot machine in Slot Katana Fruits. Start reel rounds and look for winning symbol combinations, including the game's free-spin and bonus features. The presentation pairs a katana-inspired theme with the fruit symbols and casino-style interface.

pages.title: Fishing with Friends
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Compete for catches in Fishing with Friends. Aim a harpoon at deep-water fish and use bonuses such as rapid fire, exploding nets, and a vortex. Four players share a two-minute round, combining accurate shots and score chains to pursue the winning total.

pages.title: Sisters Christmas Tree
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare a seasonal centerpiece in Sisters Christmas Tree. Help Mia and Ella decorate their tree with holiday items and coordinate the finished arrangement. Choose outfits for both sisters afterward so they are ready for their Christmas celebration.

pages.title: Angry Fish Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Add color to underwater characters in Angry Fish Coloring. Select one of eight pictures and work with the twenty-three-color palette to finish its details. Create your own combination of shades and save the completed fish illustration when it is ready.

pages.title: Birdie Tower
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Help a bird ascend in Birdie Tower. Tap to raise it while steering clear of obstacles that threaten the climb. Activate fury mode for temporary invincibility and use that opportunity to continue working toward a greater height.

pages.title: Water Boat Fun Racing
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Navigate a boat through a crowded route in Water Boat Fun Racing. Smash objects such as boxes, drums, and wheels while keeping away from rocks that end the attempt. Continue through harder levels as the obstacles make the water course less forgiving.

pages.title: Kids Memory Game: Halloween
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Remember seasonal card pictures in Kids Memory Game: Halloween. Reveal tiles and locate partners showing the same cartoon character or object. Choose among nine difficulty settings and clear the arrangement by matching every pair.

pages.title: Defuse it!
pages.creator: TırtılMedya
pages.description: Read a device's manual in Defuse it! and operate its keypad and switches before the timer expires. Enter the requested sequences and confirm them with the appropriate controls. An incorrect input generates a new code, requiring you to restart the procedure with fresh instructions.

pages.title: Traffic Run Online
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Time a car's movement through busy crossings in Traffic Run Online. Hold the mouse button to drive and release it to stop, choosing gaps between other vehicles. Reach the finish without being caught in traffic at the intersections along the route.

pages.title: Word Wood
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Build a category-appropriate answer in Word Wood. Use the spelling puzzle's theme to work out which word the level requests. Select the letters needed to complete that answer and continue to another vocabulary challenge.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Paris
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Reconstruct city photographs in Jigsaw Puzzle Paris. Sixteen images show different views of the French capital, with pieces you can drag into place. Use the eye button to view the complete picture when you need help recognizing a section.

pages.title: Real Impossible Track 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive above the city in Real Impossible Track 2. Steer along difficult elevated routes and keep the car from leaving the track. Use R to restart from a checkpoint after a mistake, then continue working through the next part of the course.

pages.title: VW Beetle Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Unlock and assemble car photographs in VW Beetle Jigsaw. Work through twelve images, choosing the puzzle mode and fitting each piece into its proper position. The untimed format lets you compare the vehicle details without a countdown interrupting the arrangement.

pages.title: Train Journeys Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together rail scenes in Train Journeys Puzzle. Choose one of six images and a layout with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Rebuild the selected train picture by matching section shapes and details at your chosen difficulty.

pages.title: Throw Sheep
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Launch an animal between trees in Throw Sheep. Pull back to line up the throw, then release to send the sheep toward the next landing. Judge the distance and direction as you work to keep the sequence of throws going.

pages.title: EG Tower Builder
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Build upward in EG Tower Builder. Place successive tower sections and keep the growing structure aligned as you aim for more height and points. Unlock additional tower appearances and work on improving the score from your previous construction attempt.

pages.title: Candy Garden Cleaning
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Restore a neglected sweet-themed setting in Candy Garden Cleaning. Visit each area to repair damage and clean away the mess. Add decorations after the work is complete, creating a finished candy garden with the appearance you prefer.

pages.title: CPL Cricket Tournament
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Chase batting targets in CPL Cricket Tournament. Choose a team and a match length of two, five, or ten overs, then tap to take each shot. Win the required matches to reach the quarterfinal while meeting the score set for the available balls.

pages.title: Ella Hip Surgery
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Complete a virtual operation in Ella Hip Surgery. Help the injured princess through the treatment sequence after a broken hip. Follow the game's prompts and use the illustrated medical tools to work on fixing the character's injury.

pages.title: Mad Hill Racing
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive across steep terrain in Mad Hill Racing. Choose a car or bike, collect coins, and perform tricks for bonuses while managing climbs and descents. Upgrade the vehicle with your earnings as you work toward reaching a greater distance.

pages.title: Dump Truck Race
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Overtake crowded road traffic in Dump Truck Race. Guide the truck past cars and other heavy vehicles while limiting collisions. Three hits destroy your truck, so balance the desire to pass more traffic with keeping enough room around the vehicle.

pages.title: Forest Mania
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Collect woodland-themed pieces in Forest Mania. Form matching groups of at least three to complete the puzzle challenges and build your score. Continue through the levels as new layouts give you different arrangements to clear.

pages.title: Modern Girls Collage Day
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose campus looks in Modern Girls Collage Day. Help the friends prepare for a new day of classes by coordinating their outfits. Compare the available fashion pieces and give each student a complete appearance for returning to college.

pages.title: Chain Reaction
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Trigger expanding blasts in Chain Reaction. Click a position to create an explosion that catches nearby moving molecules and spreads through others. Choose the moment and location to involve as many of the colorful particles as possible in one reaction.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Japanese Garden 2
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Rebuild peaceful landscape pictures in Jigsaw Puzzle: Japanese Garden 2. Sixteen garden illustrations provide different scenes to assemble from scattered pieces. Compare the plants, paths, and other image details as you work toward finishing the selected puzzle.

pages.title: Super Robo fighter 3
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Construct a fighting machine in Super Robo fighter 3. Drag robot components into their positions until the assembly is complete, then battle opposing robots. Use the finished machine to defeat the enemy lineup and work toward winning the competition.

pages.title: Animal HTML5 Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Create your own palette for creature pictures in Animal HTML5 Coloring. Choose an animal drawing and fill its outlined sections with the available colors. Work through the details to produce a finished illustration in the combination of shades you prefer.

pages.title: High Noon Hunter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight through enemy encounters in High Noon Hunter. Move and jump around threats while firing the selected weapon, then improve the arsenal between challenges. Upgrades for speed, health, and shooting abilities support later fights alongside stronger revolvers, shotguns, and other firearms.

pages.title: Gingerman Rescue
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Search for treasure in Gingerman Rescue. Guide the character through a series of platforming stages and work toward recovering the valuables along the journey. The adventure centers on helping Gingerman complete the route to the treasure he is seeking.

pages.title: 2048 Cuteness Edition
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Merge creature tiles in 2048 Cuteness Edition. Slide the board with the arrow keys or swipe controls so identical animals meet and combine. Keep building higher-value tiles while preserving enough space to continue toward the 2048 goal.

pages.title: Spanish card
pages.creator: kiko vidal
pages.description: Find card partners before time expires in Spanish card. Compare the available pictures and select matching pairs to work through the arrangement. Keep completing pairs within the countdown as you try to clear the remaining cards.

pages.title: Emmas Lost Toys
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Search familiar locations for misplaced playthings in Emmas Lost Toys. Visit places such as the mall, park, and city streets where Emma thinks she left them. Find her favorite toys across four levels and complete the collection she has lost.

pages.title: Angle
pages.creator: LichcrazeLC
pages.description: Solve geometric missions in Angle. Select an angle, rotate it clockwise or counterclockwise, and increase or reduce its size to match the task. Use the degree display and remaining resource information to assess each adjustment before completing the arrangement.

pages.title: Princess Style Guide 2017: Coachella
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Create festival looks in Princess Style Guide 2017: Coachella. Help Ariel and Moana explore ethnic, bohemian, and hippie-inspired fashion choices. Coordinate the outfits and accessories into styles suited to the magazine's music-festival theme.

pages.title: Highschool Geek
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Prepare school looks in Highschool Geek. Choose clothes and accessories such as glasses, bags, and headphones for the teenagers, then consider a different hairstyle. Combine unusual choices with the wardrobe pieces to create individual outfits for class.

pages.title: Ellie And Annie Doll House
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Redecorate two interiors in Ellie And Annie Doll House. Help each girl select furnishings and design elements for a small home being prepared for sale. Coordinate the choices into complete rooms that suit the look you want for each house.

pages.title: Kitty Pregnant Checkup
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help an expectant cat through a medical visit in Kitty Pregnant Checkup. Take her temperature, use an ultrasound tool, and complete the remaining care activities. Finish the appointment with options such as music and belly decorations for the character.
